MUSIC AND DANCE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #7
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MUSIC AND DANCE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Kenyan Contemporary Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Contemporary Songs.
   B. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Contemporary Songs.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Contemporary Songs.
   D. Practise Kenyan Contemporary Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. Best practice when working on Kenyan -Western Instrumental Ensemble: (1 mark)

   D. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan -Western Instrumental Ensemble.

   A. Only the volume
   B. Only the costume
   C. The speed of the music
